sculptor.title: Sculptor Biotherapy
sculptor.subtitle: Remodelling · Drainage and Silhouette
sculptor.summary: A slimming treatment inspired by Quantum Physics that mobilises accumulated fat and restores cellular order.

tabs.description: The Sculptor Body Biotherapy by Secretos del Agua, inspired by Quantum Physics, visibly reduces the fatty nodules of cellulite. Thanks to the action of Biopolar Water™, a liquid nanostructure that drives the cellular system to recover its original order, this intensive treatment combines draining massage with biological fat-burning actives to reshape the silhouette and restore the skin's natural firmness.
tabs.benefits:
• Reduces localised volume.
• Drains fluids and toxins.
• Improves the appearance of cellulite.
• Smooths and firms the skin.
tabs.ideal:
• You want to reduce volume in localised areas.
• You notice fluid retention.
• You have cellulite or orange-peel skin.
• You want to reshape your silhouette.
tabs.actives: Natural Caffeine, Ivy, Horse Chestnut, Fucus.

colorluz.title: Colour Light Biotherapy
colorluz.subtitle: Vitality · Luminosity and Antioxidant
colorluz.summary: A rejuvenating ritual that protects the skin from oxidative damage and brings a radiant glow.

tabs.description: A nourishing biotherapy with high antioxidant power that evens out body tone and leaves the skin velvety and full of light. It protects against premature ageing.
tabs.benefits:
• Intensely hydrates and softens.
• Deep antioxidant action.
• Brings a silky luminosity.
• Evens out skin tone.
tabs.ideal:
• Your body skin is dry or dull.
• You notice a lack of glow and softness.
• You want to prevent body skin ageing.
• You are looking for a relaxing sensory ritual.
tabs.actives: Natural Vitamin E, Almond Oil, Calendula, Sesame.

piernas.title: Perfect Legs Biotherapy
piernas.subtitle: Lightness · Relief and Circulation
piernas.summary: Immediate relief for tired, heavy legs, boosting venous return.

tabs.description: A biological cold ritual that decongests and tones the legs, eliminating the feeling of heaviness and accumulated fatigue by reactivating circulation.
tabs.benefits:
• Immediate relief from tiredness.
• Reduces swelling and congestion.
• Activates microcirculation.
• A feeling of extreme lightness.
tabs.ideal:
• Your legs feel heavy or swollen.
• You spend long hours standing or sitting.
• You have mild circulatory issues.
• You are looking for deep rest.
tabs.actives: Peppermint, Camphor, Butcher's Broom, Witch Hazel.
